```yaml
id: T-fa09c96c-fc1f-4838-8272-f2cce8c7a495

related_task_id: null
relation: main
depends_on: ["T-c287ebc6-15ef-42e8-b2b6-f72c5da5820d"]
```

Goal:
- Resolve a topic and one or more intake batch IDs into a verified exact task selection.

- Extend read-only selectors and guarded start in `.skill-tree/common/scripts/workflow-state.py`. Update `.skill-tree/templates/operations.json` and the processing and controller contracts.

- Support exact topic and union of explicit batch IDs, with intersection when both filters apply. Use UTC receipt times for a recent-batches view and let the owner select adjacent batches explicitly. A missing or invalid explicit selection stops. No implicit time-based grouping.
- Return exact eligible P or T IDs and inspected queue hash before mutation. Report required dependencies outside the selection. Process receives exact P IDs. Implement All receives exact T IDs through `snapshot_ids`. Recheck the inspected source revision under the writer before reservation or mutation.
- Preserve priority and document tie order, exact readiness and dependency closure. Later additions and retagging leave a frozen run scope unchanged. Legacy tasks remain available by exact ID or ordinary full queue selection.
